demonstrations: three separate swap/in_box examples at lengths0,1,3 and target labels A,D,G; same prefix for every query condition
parser: first response prefix is optional box plus one uppercase label A-H followed by whitespace, punctuation or end
limitations: Diagnostic only: no intervention, no test-set claim, no new competence certification.
The same eight semantic pairs per depth are reused across cues, wordings and sides; responses are not independent.
Zero/one-swap examples are sanity checks; lengths three/four require at least two relevant moves for both sides.
The common demonstration prefix deliberately stays fixed while query wording and cue vary.
Normalized answers are a new diagnostic metric, not a replacement for original next-token accuracy.
This simpler diagnostic omits the original irrelevant final swap and cannot establish equivalence to the original harder task.
